text: Blockchain enabled per transaction fees align fees with strategy turnover: clients in transaction intensive strategies agree upfront to higher fees while clients in less transaction rich strategies pay lower overall fees.
citation: Wulf A. Kaal, Blockchain Innovation for Private Investment Funds (2017). SSRN: https://ssrn.com/abstract=2998033

isBasedOn.name: Blockchain Innovation for Private Investment Funds

abstract: Accordingly, clients who invest in a more transaction-prone strategy will be able to agree upfront to higher fees whereas clients who invest in a less transaction-rich strategy will pay overall lower fees.

additionalProperty.name: scope_conditions
value: assumes the per transaction fee is predetermined with clients and can be made publicly available
